collection.title: Mini Clubvan 2013 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mini Clubvan 2012 to 2015 model which requires a 18" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
